question: What universal range must be encompassed when meditating in each place?
premises: Meditation is performed in each place.
The object meditated upon extends from Śiva to Avīci.
The range covers the entire cosmic spectrum.
inference: In each place one should meditate on that which extends from Śiva down to Avīci.
plain_english: Indeed, in each and every place, having meditated on that which extends from Śiva down to Avīci.
